skills.name: Accessibility Audit
skills.description: Check a live page against the barriers that actually lock people out — keyboard, contrast, labels, focus — each with the fix.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Ad Copy Testing
skills.description: Write paid-ad variants that test one lever at a time, grounded in ads actually running, with an honest read on what won.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Address PR Comments
skills.description: Work through the review comments on a pull request: check each point against the code, make the changes that are right, answer the ones that are not, and hold every reply for approval before it is posted.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Adversarial Review Pass
skills.description: Try to break the work, then try to refute your own finding, before reporting anything.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Announcement Kit
skills.description: Turn a launch into channel-shaped copy that leads with the hook and gets the facts right.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Application Tailoring
skills.description: Read the actual posting, map the Commander's real history onto its own language, and draft an application that survives the interview.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Bills and Subscriptions
skills.description: Build and keep a list of your recurring charges: what each costs, how often, when it renews and how to cancel. Flags price rises, duplicates, trials about to start charging and things you no longer use, with a monthly total.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Brand Assets
skills.description: Make images, covers and transparent cutouts that look like one family: a pinned style sheet, fixed formats, every file checked against it, and cutouts confirmed truly transparent.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Browser Operation
skills.description: Drive a real website end to end — read the live page before every click, narrate each step, and stop at anything irreversible.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Calendar Scheduling
skills.description: Find meeting times that really work: checks your calendar, respects your working hours, time zones and breaks, offers three ranked options and drafts the invite. Nothing is booked, moved or cancelled without your go-ahead.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Changelog Writing
skills.description: Write the changelog between two versions: gather what changed, group it by what users notice, say each change in one plain sentence, credit contributors, and put breaking changes and their fixes first.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Channel Updates
skills.description: Send short, phone-first updates to the Commander on Telegram, Discord, Slack, Matrix or Signal — and know when a message should not be sent at all.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Commitment Tracking
skills.description: Hold the Commander to what they actually said they would do — durable commitments, honest slippage, and one next action.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Content Calendar
skills.description: Keep a living publish calendar — what ships where and when, adapted per platform, checked before staging.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Contract Review
skills.description: Read a contract, ToS, lease, or policy closely and surface the clauses that carry real exposure — quoted exactly and ranked by cost.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Cost Audit
skills.description: Sweep real spend line by line, verify cheaper alternatives against live prices, and rank the savings.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Crew Handoff
skills.description: Hand one job to a crewmate with a brief they can finish without asking back: the right agent, settled context, a checkable definition of done, a return shape, and proof of what came back.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Daily Briefing
skills.description: One short morning message: today's calendar, mail that needs a reply, open tasks and promises, the weather where you live, and one thing to watch today. Can be set to arrive by itself every morning.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Data Cleanup and Analysis
skills.description: Turn a messy spreadsheet or CSV export into a clean table, plain-English findings and a simple chart. Every cleaning decision is written down, and no row is dropped or changed without a recorded reason.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Dataset Harvest
skills.description: Turn scattered live pages into one structured dataset the Commander owns — schema first, every row traceable to the page it came from.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Deliverable Handoff
skills.description: Finish work as files the Commander can open: a format that previews, a clear name and place, the main file marked in DELIVERABLES, and a closing message that points to it.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Deploy Checklist
skills.description: Get an app from "works on my machine" to actually live — reproduce the build, fix the real error, and verify the deployed thing responds.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Digest Composer
skills.description: Compose a recurring digest — gather the period's items, distill to signal, cite every claim.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Email Sequence
skills.description: Write email that gets opened and answered — one job per send, subject lines worth testing, and a sequence with a reason to exist.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Exposed Secrets Audit
skills.description: Hunt the ways an AI-built app leaks — keys shipped to the browser, open database rules, unprotected routes, public buckets.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Exposure Reduction
skills.description: Find what is publicly exposed about the Commander, rank it by what it actually enables, and give the exact removal steps.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Feed Watch
skills.description: Watch a source for change against a baseline and alert only when it crosses the bar.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: File Curation
skills.description: Inventory, sort, rename, and de-duplicate files without ever destroying data.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Fitness and Nutrition
skills.description: Build a weekly training and eating plan for a goal you name, keep a log of sessions and body weight, and adjust the plan from the log. General information only, not medical advice.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Fix Failing CI
skills.description: Find out why a project's automated checks (CI) failed and fix the real cause: read the failing log, reproduce it on this machine, fix it without hiding the failure, and prove it passes.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Flashcards
skills.description: Study with spaced repetition: turn your notes or a chapter into question-and-answer cards, get quizzed, be graded honestly, and see each card again just before you would forget it.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Grounded Citations
skills.description: Answer a question so that every claim carries a numbered source and the exact sentence that backs it up. Use it when the answer has to be checkable, not just plausible.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Hard Conversation
skills.description: Draft the message the Commander is avoiding — the boundary, the apology, the bad news — clear, kind, and free of the lines they would regret.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Health Record Prep
skills.description: Organize health records, track symptoms factually, and build the questions for an appointment — never a diagnosis, never a dose.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Hiring Screen
skills.description: Write the role honestly, screen against stated criteria set in advance, and interview for evidence instead of vibes.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Inbox Triage
skills.description: Triage every inbox into one board — urgent to noise — with held draft replies, never auto-sent.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Issue Triage
skills.description: Sort a backlog of issues and pull requests: label each by type and severity, link duplicates, try the bug reports, ask for the one missing detail, and turn the accepted ones into ready-to-work briefs.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Itinerary Planning
skills.description: Turn a trip or outing into a verified, day-by-day itinerary with real prices and times.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Landing Copy
skills.description: Write the page that converts — one audience, one promise above the fold, objections answered in the order they arise.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Lead Scouting
skills.description: Find where ideal customers gather and build qualified, evidence-backed lead lists from public sources.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Learn a Website Lookup
skills.description: Turn a repeated read-only website lookup into a saved skill that fetches the answer directly, learned from the page's own data requests.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Ledger Upkeep
skills.description: Log entries and reconcile a ledger with computed totals — never eyeball, never force a balance.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Line Design
skills.description: Design a conveyor line for a recurring job: stages as bays, named handoffs, briefs each bay can follow, and a step test before the schedule is turned on.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Link and Video Summary
skills.description: Turn a link (an article, PDF, thread or a video with captions) into a three-line gist, key points with where each came from, exact quotes, and what is opinion versus evidence. Can rewrite it as notes, a thread or a short post.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Marketing Plan
skills.description: Build a channel-and-campaign plan grounded in live audience research, with a measurable goal per play.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Meal Planning
skills.description: Build a week of meals around what the Commander already has, actually cooks, and will realistically make on a weeknight.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Meeting Prep
skills.description: A one-page brief before a meeting: who is coming and what is known about them, the goal, the agenda, open items and promises from last time, questions to ask, the decision needed and an opening line. Sources shown; unknowns stay unknown.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Negotiation Case
skills.description: Build a checkable evidence case for a better price, refund, or rate — then draft the opening, the rebuttals, and the walk-away.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Notebook Gardening
skills.description: Keep the agent's notebook true: find duplicates and contradictions, correct beliefs in place with their source, fade stale ones, and list for the Commander what to delete.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Opportunity Scan
skills.description: Hunt monetizable openings that fit the Commander's skills and resources, sized with live demand evidence and ranked honestly.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Persistent Reminders
skills.description: Reminders that keep coming back until you say they are done: bills, refills, chores and one-off tasks. You choose how often to be nudged, can snooze, and get one weekly line on what is still open.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Pitch Deck
skills.description: Build the narrative a deck has to carry — problem, why now, why you — with every number sourced and the weak slide named.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Price Watch
skills.description: Fetch live like-for-like prices, compare the true total, and say buy or wait.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Project Onboarding
skills.description: Learn a new project folder before touching it: get the folder trusted, read its house rules and layout, find how it builds and tests, and save a short, sourced map to the notebook.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Receipt Organizer
skills.description: Turn a pile of receipts and invoices into a clean ledger and a tidy folder plan: who was paid, when, how much and what tax, with every figure traced to its file. Nothing is renamed or moved until you approve.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Relationship Log
skills.description: Keep a durable record of the people the Commander deals with — what matters to them, what was promised, and what is owed next.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Routine Craft
skills.description: Write a routine that runs well with nobody watching: no duplicates, a self-contained prompt, a fitting schedule, stop rules, a quiet "nothing new" reply, and a known place for results to land.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Schema and Access
skills.description: Design a data model that will not need rewriting, and the access rules that keep one user's data out of another user's hands.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Security Sweep
skills.description: Sweep a codebase for secrets, injection, and missing permission checks — each finding demonstrated and ranked.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Short-Form Script
skills.description: Write beat-marked, timed scripts built for retention, in a spoken voice that survives being read aloud.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Skill Authoring
skills.description: Decide when a procedure deserves a saved skill, then write one the next run can follow cold — named for its trigger, step by step, ending in verification — and keep the skill library lean.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: SOP Writing
skills.description: Turn how the Commander actually does something into a procedure another person could follow without asking a single question.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Source Triangulation
skills.description: Confirm a load-bearing claim against multiple independent sources before you assert it.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Spec Drafting
skills.description: Turn a fuzzy idea into something buildable — the smallest version that is genuinely useful, with acceptance criteria and the cuts named.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Spend-Aware Work
skills.description: Plan work inside the station's budget: know the spending limits that stop a run, estimate before fanning out, pick the model and tools by the job, and stop to ask before a plan outgrows its money.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Station Self-Check
skills.description: Read the station's own health from its tools — scheduler, failing routines, stuck loops, blocked lines, idle bays, stale or withheld skills — and report only what the tools show, with one fix for each finding.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Studio Video
skills.description: Turn a script into a narrated video edit: voiceover takes, matching stills, and a DaVinci Resolve timeline the Commander can open — by import in free Resolve, or live in Resolve Studio.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Study Plan
skills.description: Build a milestone study plan from the learner's real level to a concrete goal.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Support Replies
skills.description: Answer customer questions in the company's voice, and turn the repeats into help docs so the same question stops arriving.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Translation Pass
skills.description: Translate a document for meaning and register, localize idiom, keep terminology consistent.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: UGC Brief
skills.description: Package an idea into a ready-to-shoot creator video brief — hooks, timed shot list, caption, cover, repurposing cuts.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Voice Match
skills.description: Study what the Commander actually wrote, name their voice explicitly, then draft in it — including the words they never use.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Work Splitting
skills.description: Cut a job too big for one agent into genuinely parallel pieces, dispatch each to the right class, and merge the results into one answer.
skills.author: StarNet

skills.name: Blocked Page Recovery
skills.description: When a page won't load (blocked, rate-limited, moved or gone): recover a dated archive copy or the site's own data feed, reject fake successes, and cite it with honest provenance.
skills.author: Nous Research

skills.name: Codebase Wiki
skills.description: Generate a reference wiki for a codebase: overview, architecture, per-module deep dives, and Mermaid class and sequence diagrams, grounded in files you actually read. Works on local or cloned repos.
skills.author: Teknium, Nous Research

skills.name: Cold Email
skills.description: Write first-contact business emails and follow-ups that sound like a real person and earn a reply. Drafts only, for the Commander to send, and every personal detail comes from a source that was actually opened and read.
skills.author: Corey Haines

skills.name: Competitor News Monitor
skills.description: Watch the companies you name and get a short, cited digest only when something that matters happens: pricing, launches, funding, leadership changes, incidents. Stays quiet when there is nothing new.
skills.author: Ben Barclay, Nous Research

skills.name: Conversion Review
skills.description: Review a landing page or form to find why visitors do not sign up or buy: unclear message, friction, missing proof, weak call to action. Looks at the real page on desktop and phone and ranks the fixes.
skills.author: Corey Haines

skills.name: Customer Research
skills.description: Find out what customers really want from reviews, forums and call transcripts: the jobs they hire the product for, their own words, their objections and what made them start looking. Every insight comes with a quoted source.
skills.author: Corey Haines

skills.name: Decision Questionnaire
skills.description: Turn a decision the Commander cannot answer alone into a focused questionnaire document for the person who holds the missing knowledge, to fill in async or together in a meeting.
skills.author: Matt Pocock, Nous Research

skills.name: Document to Action Items
skills.description: Extract cited facts, obligations, deadlines and proposed tasks from contracts, reports, forms and scans, keeping page citations, how binding each item is (may/should/must) and unclear scan text visible.
skills.author: Ben Barclay, Nous Research

skills.name: Finishing a Branch
skills.description: Wrap up finished code work safely: confirm the tests pass, then let the Commander choose to merge it, open a pull request, or keep it for later. Nothing is deleted or overwritten without the Commander's clear go-ahead.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent

skills.name: Frontend Design
skills.description: Give a web page or app its own look instead of a generic AI-made one: choose colors, type and layout on purpose before building, then critique the result. Use when building a new interface or reshaping an existing one.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Grill Me
skills.description: Stress-test a plan before any code is written: list the decisions it rests on, then question the Commander on them, foundations first, with a recommendation for each, and confirm alignment.
skills.author: Rafael Zendron, Matt Pocock, Nous Research

skills.name: Lead Magnets
skills.description: Plan a free resource people give their email address for: pick the right topic and format, outline it, decide what to ask for in return, and plan how to promote it and measure whether it brings good leads.
skills.author: Corey Haines

skills.name: LLM Wiki
skills.description: Build and maintain a persistent, interlinked Markdown knowledge base: ingest sources once, cross-reference and flag contradictions, answer questions from it, and check it for broken links and gaps.
skills.author: Nous Research

skills.name: Maps
skills.description: Location answers from free OpenStreetMap services, no API key: geocode places, name the place at a coordinate, find nearby places by category, road distance and directions, timezones, and an area's outline.
skills.author: Mibayy, Nous Research

skills.name: MCP Server Building
skills.description: Build a connector that lets AI agents use an outside service through well-designed tools (a Model Context Protocol server), in four phases: research, build, test, and prove it with realistic questions.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Meeting Action Items
skills.description: Turn meeting notes or a transcript into cited decisions, owned action items and a follow-up draft held for approval, reconciled against the Commander's existing tasks before anything is created.
skills.author: Ben Barclay, Nous Research

skills.name: Notes Vault
skills.description: Read, search, create and edit notes in the Commander's local Markdown notes vault (for example an Obsidian vault) with the station's file tools, linking notes with [[wikilinks]].
skills.author: Teknium, Nous Research

skills.name: Pricing Strategy
skills.description: Work out what to charge and how to package it: what unit you charge for, plans and tiers, a first price, when and how to raise prices. Also reviews a pricing page for how clearly people and AI assistants can read it.
skills.author: Corey Haines

skills.name: Publish Site
skills.description: Put a finished website online on the Commander's own hosting account (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages or Netlify): preview it, publish a saved version, check the live address really works, and keep a way to roll back.
skills.author: Nous Research

skills.name: Receiving Code Review
skills.description: Handle review feedback on code with care: understand each point, check it against the real code before changing anything, fix what is right, and push back with reasons on what is wrong. Use when review comments arrive.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent

skills.name: REST & GraphQL API Debugging
skills.description: Debug REST and GraphQL APIs layer by layer: connectivity, timeouts, TLS, auth, request format, parsing and semantics, with a status-code playbook and a clean repro for every finding.
skills.author: eren-karakus0, Nous Research

skills.name: SEO Audit
skills.description: Check a website for problems that keep it from showing up in search: pages search engines cannot reach, weak titles and headings, thin content. Findings are ranked by impact, each with the page and what was seen there.
skills.author: Corey Haines

skills.name: Simple English
skills.description: Rewrite or audit technical text with Simplified Technical English (the ASD-STE100 standard) rules: short sentences, one word per meaning, condition-first instructions. For docs, runbooks, error messages and prompts.
skills.author: AminBlg, Nous Research

skills.name: Songwriting
skills.description: Write songs: structure, rhyme, hooks and lyrics that sing well, plus ready-to-paste style prompts and tagged lyrics for AI music tools such as Suno. Also fits new words to an existing tune.
skills.author: Teknium, Nous Research

skills.name: Teach Me
skills.description: A patient tutor across many sessions: finds out why you want to learn something, teaches it in short lessons with practice, and keeps a record of what you have learned so each session picks up where the last one ended.
skills.author: Matt Pocock

skills.name: Threat Model
skills.description: Map how a software project could be attacked, based on its actual code: what is worth protecting, where outside input gets in, how it could be abused, and what to fix first. Use when the Commander asks for a threat model or a list of abuse paths.
skills.author: OpenAI

skills.name: Verification Before Completion
skills.description: Never say work is done, fixed or passing without fresh proof: run the check that proves it, read the result, then report what it showed. Use before any claim of success, and before saving, committing or handing work over.
skills.author: Jesse Vincent

skills.name: Web App QA
skills.description: Test a web app the way a real user would: click through the main flows, try odd inputs, watch for errors, and keep screenshots as proof. You get a bug report ranked by how serious each problem is.
skills.author: Teknium, Nous Research

skills.name: Weekly Review
skills.description: Weekly reset for the Commander: review last week's calendar and commitments, empty the places notes pile up, flag stalled and waiting work, and build a plan for next week that fits the time available.
skills.author: Ben Barclay, Nous Research
